en.title: Try the new HikariSub 0.1 beta
highlights: Dockable panels with Editing, Timing, Translation, Typesetting and Karaoke layouts, each tab with its own.
Visual typesetting on the video, including a perspective tool, and a fullscreen player.
Karaoke: split and time syllables on the waveform, tap to time, and preview templates live on the video.
Translation mode keeps the original text beside yours, with spelling and grammar checks.
Light, Dark and high-contrast themes, a Home page with your recent files, and autosave with crash recovery.
en.note: This is a beta. It installs over 0.0.x and only reads its settings, so you can go back by reinstalling 0.0.x at any time.
